title: Pair Sum
instructions:
Write a function called `hasPairWithSum` that takes a `List<Int>` called `numbers` and an `Int` called `target`. It should return `true` if any two different elements in the list add up to the target.

For example, `hasPairWithSum(listOf(1, 3, 5, 7), 8)` should return `true` because 1 + 7 = 8.
hint: Use two nested loops. The outer loop picks the first number (index i). The inner loop picks the second number (index j, starting from i + 1). Check if they add up to the target.
